title: Müller to Bartsch, 8 May 1631
author: Philipp Müller
summary: Müller replies to Bartsch about the copies he has received and their prices, advises printing the second volume of the *Ephemerides* at home, sends a gift for Kepler's grandson, and quotes Crüger's excuse for writing no poem on Kepler's death.

notes.on: the will shall always be there
notes.note: After Ovid, *Epistulae ex Ponto* 3.4.79: “though the strength be lacking, the will is to be praised.”
